title: 真昼の雨と、銀の鈴の音
author: 朝霧 ゆい

en.title: Midday Rain and the Sound of a Silver Bell
en.premise: Set in a corner coffee shop in a shopping district, people caught up in mysterious phenomena cross paths. One day, as if cursed by a 'spell that prevents them with lying,' the people in the shop begin to blurt out their small, hidden secrets. An old photograph brought by a nameless cat unravels a gentle misunderstanding hidden within the town. A story of small, everyday happiness aimed at a resolution where no one gets hurt.

zh.title: 正午的雨与银铃之声
zh.premise: 以商业街角落的一家咖啡店为舞台，被卷入不可思议现象的人们在此交汇。一天巧合聚在店里的人们，仿佛中了“无法说谎的诅咒”一般，开始说出自己隐藏的小秘密。一只无名猫咪带来的一张老旧照片，解开了隐藏在小镇里的温柔误会。这是一个旨在寻求无人受伤的结局、交织着日常微小幸福的故事。
